set.body: Port working align/claimassessment.scala and ClaimAssessmentReceiptSuite behavior into idiomatic Python with a connected API/CLI sidecar over immutable checked mapping/account context. Freeze question population independently of extraction success. Preserve supporting and counterevidence, source citation ownership (origin may differ from assessed target), reviewed and expressed recall spans, assessor/procedure provenance, one submission per question, and derived Supported/Contradicted/Conflicted/Unresolved/NotExpressed/ExtractionUnresolved/ReferenceUnresolved states. Counts are question accounting, not accuracy/probability; never infer reviewed absence from missing extraction or overwrite existing reference/fidelity. Read complete Scala contracts/tests/callers first; use existing strict instance/JSON boundaries and deterministic IDs. Explicitly track text vs playback/chart support gaps rather than silently weakening them; future full specialized coverage remains owed. Execute recurring-cast/action and changed-attribute controls alongside existing direct and structural routes. Keep unit-only/order-independent mapping usable: absent graph/neighbor context does not prove it incapable of recurring-scene localization. Legacy mapping/account artifacts unchanged, independent cases/mutations and installed readback required. Current code pointer: claimassessment.scala lines1-282, status derivation near100, complete accounting near215; full question/source/reference validation is the useful new capability, not merely another synthetic proposal.
set.title: P3 fixed-population attributed claim assessment
